proposals.evidence: Turner grāma explicitly includes the extended family grāmaṭikā, Prakrit gāmaḍa village and Gujarati gāmṛũ small village. The western survey gamḍ-/gāvḍ- village forms are compared with this documented extension, not with grāmārdha neighbourhood solely because of similar consonants.
